properties.name: Main mezzanine, passages and PATH hall

evidence.note: 13 ft below the street: the official rise of the escalators down to the PATH hall at 32nd St, which the long passage joins to the north mezzanine with no machine between. The north mezzanine's own depth is not listed: EL213's rise is blank. nycsubway.org's depths fit this. Opening and landing construction is illustrative: 0.65 m end plates, 2.5 m opening headroom, guard profiles and door thresholds are not surveyed dimensions. Existing source tiers and equipment endpoints are retained. The outline is the MTA's three outlines and the halls drawn here, with a margin: it is not the walls.

Design proposal: two equal 2.4 m flights aligned on one plan centreline and connected by a 2.4 m landing. Broader original stair width retained as design baseline; no slab apron beneath the sloped upper flight. Dimensions and heights assumed, not surveyed. The outline is the MTA's three outlines and the halls drawn here, with a margin: it is not the walls.
